## Activity

During May 2024, Hill Counties Health Centre completed 115 captures. Activity was delivered through the clinic team, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. Overall, the month’s activity was recorded in the site operations report for Hill Counties Health Centre.

The capture total provides the activity measure for the month and forms the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below. No disruption to the planned session lists was recorded beyond routine leave.

## Image quality

Graders marked 10 sets ungradable. The ungradable rate was 8.7 of all captures. These results indicate the proportion of submitted images that could not be graded and are reported alongside the total capture activity for May 2024.

## Grading

A total of 25 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2. This is the reported midpoint for the time taken to complete grading during the month.

Together, the grading results and image-quality findings provide a summary of the site’s operational performance. Activity continued as planned at Hill Counties Health Centre, subject to routine leave, and the month’s captures were processed through the grading workflow.
